messages.text: what does it mean "Standard Shipping, customs & duties prepaid (DDP)"?

DDP stands for delivered duty paid. It means the customs charges and import duties for that shipment are paid up front as part of the shipping rate, so the courier doesn't stop the parcel and ask you for money at the door.

One thing worth separating: duties and VAT aren't always the same bill. Where are you having it shipped? Tell me the country and I'll tell you exactly what, if anything, is still payable on delivery for the Magic Miner 40T.

For I., the Magic Miner 40T is $799 and it ships from our US warehouse. The listed price is the unit only. Italian import VAT at 21% is charged on delivery, not at checkout, so budget roughly $168 on top. Duties are the recipient's side too, and I can't quote what your customs office will raise.

Shipping cost is separate and checkout does show that once you put your address in.

Want me to put one in a cart so you can see the shipping number?
in the magic miner page i can see "Import VAT included in price - Ships from within EU"

Then the page is right and I was wrong, sorry. That line is drawn for your country, and it means your unit ships from the EU warehouse with import VAT already in the $799. Nothing extra to pay on delivery, and the DDP shipping line means no duty at the door either.

So $799 plus whatever shipping comes up at checkout, and that's the lot.

Want me to build the cart?
is the italian cable provided with this?

It ships with the EU power cable, and the miner side is a standard IEC C14 socket, 100-240V. What I don't want to guess is whether the EU kit is a Schuko plug or an Italian Type L, since plenty of Italian sockets take Schuko and some don't.

Let me get that confirmed rather than invent it. Worst case it's a few euro for a C13 cable with an Italian plug, any of them work.

What's your email so the answer reaches you?
